intro: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.
description:
Play as Maude, a graffiti artist compelled to tag up the walls of a nightclub at every possible opportunity. As you move your way past bouncers and club goers you come to discover there’s more to Club Soko than meets the eye.

Game Features:
- Over 100+ handcrafted puzzles
- An undo system to work through past mistakes
- 6 chapters each with their own music
- 13 unlockable cameo characters to discover from other true indie devs, artists, and indie games!
- 11 different kinds of puzzle pieces
- 2 types of secret rooms to find
- A chill music mode
- A puke toggle!
- The first puzzle game in the world with a circle pit!
